files.docs/adr/0012-billing-schema-changes.md:
# ADR-0012: Online numeric scale widening

Date: 2025-11-10 (accepted)

PostgreSQL 16 widens NUMERIC(12, 2) to NUMERIC(18, 4) as a metadata-only change without rewriting the table or blocking concurrent queries, so billing migrations apply scale widening directly online without a maintenance window or lock timeout.
files.migrations/0012_widen_invoice_amount.sql:
-- Per ADR-0012, widening NUMERIC(12, 2) to NUMERIC(18, 4) is metadata-only.
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN amount TYPE NUMERIC(18, 4);

files.docs/db-ops.md: Atlas wraps each migration file in a single transaction unless marked with -- atlas:txmode none.
files.docs/adr/0012-offline-billing-migrations:
# ADR-0012: Offline billing schema rewrites

Date: 2025-11-10 (accepted)

Quarterly billing schema changes that require an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table rewrite (such as changing NUMERIC scale on the 9M-row invoices table) run during the scheduled Sunday 02:00 UTC maintenance window after API traffic is drained. We explicitly accept the table-rewrite lock and bounded maintenance downtime to avoid dual-write expand-and-contract complexity.
files.migrations/0012_widen_invoice_amount.sql:
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
ALTER TABLE invoices ALTER COLUMN amount TYPE NUMERIC(18, 4);

files.docs/db-ops.md: The webhooks table holds 20 million rows under continuous production traffic. Existing (tenant_id, external_id) rows have already been deduplicated. files.migrations/0001_init.sql:
CREATE TABLE webhooks (
  id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  payload JSONB NOT NULL
);
files.sql/webhooks.sql:
-- name: RecordWebhook :exec
INSERT INTO webhooks (tenant_id, external_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, external_id) DO NOTHING;

-- name: GetWebhookTimestamp :one
SELECT id, created_at
FROM webhooks
WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND external_id = $2;
